enabled.Description: If this config allows users to sign in with the provider.

idp_config.Description: SAML IdP configuration when the project acts as the relying party

idp_certificates.Description: The IdP's certificate data to verify the signature in the SAMLResponse issued by the IDP.

idp_entity_id.Description: Unique identifier for all SAML entities

sign_request.Description: Indicates if outbounding SAMLRequest should be signed.

sso_url.Description: URL to send Authentication request to.

name.Description:
The name of the InboundSamlConfig resource. Must start with 'saml.' and can only have alphanumeric characters,
hyphens, underscores or periods. The part after 'saml.' must also start with a lowercase letter, end with an
alphanumeric character, and have at least 2 characters.

sp_config.Description:
SAML SP (Service Provider) configuration when the project acts as the relying party to receive
and accept an authentication assertion issued by a SAML identity provider.

callback_uri.Description: Callback URI where responses from IDP are handled. Must start with 'https://'.

sp_certificates.Description: The IDP's certificate data to verify the signature in the SAMLResponse issued by the IDP.

sp_entity_id.Description: Unique identifier for all SAML entities.
